correctness.rationale: Even regular n has scale-free x=θ/(πsinθ), y=cosθ/4 for θ=π/n. Direct differentiation gives positive d²y/dx² on (0,π/4], using g(θ)=2θcos2θ+4θ−3sin2θ, g′=4h, h′′=4θsin2θ>0 with vanishing initial data; hence strict square–disk chord separation. Odd n and even 2n have the same x but the even y exceeds odd y by sin²(π/(2n))/(4cos(π/(2n)))>0. Every Fα=(1−α)x+αy is bounded by the larger endpoint, square or disk; equality and attainment follow from strictness, crossover exact α*=2(√2π−4)/(π(√2+2)−8). Independent exact symbolic derivatives, odd-even identity and crossover check. This does not solve the global convex-body problem.
residual_risks: Only finite regular polygons and limiting disk; not all convex bodies.
